3a6d5ff4-efec-4e53-b8ea-af3333cbc5d2/Eve.en: "I do not believe we've met before.<NL>Who are you? Why do you seek to take my True Qi and do me harm?"<NL>Father called out to the dummy sitting on the ground.<NL><NL>The dummy, on the other hand, remained completely motionless and still. You couldn't help but begin to worry about your foster father...
3a6d5ff4-efec-4e53-b8ea-af3333cbc5d2/Eve.cn: “阁下何方神圣？<NL>何以夺我真气？暗害于我？！”<NL>“义父”向那端坐在地的木人问道……<NL><NL>焕心见那木人动也不动，不禁为“义父”担心起来……

3a6d5ff4-efec-4e53-b8ea-af3333cbc5d2/Opt.en: "'Foster father' was obsessed with the manual and just suffered from True Qi leakage... Could it have damaged his mind?"
3a6d5ff4-efec-4e53-b8ea-af3333cbc5d2/Opt.cn: ‘义父’醉心秘本，方才又遭真气外泄之祸……莫非损伤了心智么？
3a6d5ff4-efec-4e53-b8ea-af3333cbc5d2/Opt.ru: ""Приемный отец" был помешан на руководстве и просто страдал от утечки Истинной ци... Могло ли это повредить его рассудку?"

d43d87b6-e902-467b-9f0e-1f8c1d9a2682/Eve.en: Just as doubt began to sprout up in your mind,<NL>the wooden dummy suddenly stood up and laughed almost mechanically!
d43d87b6-e902-467b-9f0e-1f8c1d9a2682/Eve.cn: 正当焕心心生疑虑之时，<NL>那端坐在地的木人突然站起身来，咯嘎一笑！
d43d87b6-e902-467b-9f0e-1f8c1d9a2682/Eve.ru: Как раз в тот момент, когда в вашем сознании начали зарождаться сомнения,<NL>деревянный манекен внезапно встал и почти механически рассмеялся!

2a270214-1850-4383-ba98-7bffb6ac7bf4/Eve.en: "Haha, looks like I was one move behind. I didn't think this little girl would return so quickly!"<NL>The wooden dummy opened its mouth to speak, sounding almost like two pieces of wood banging together. "Why don't you take a guess who I am?"<NL><NL>You passed glances between your foster father and the speaking dummy, as bewildered as if you were dreaming!
2a270214-1850-4383-ba98-7bffb6ac7bf4/Eve.cn: “哈哈，是老夫棋差一着！想不到小女娃回来的这般快！”<NL>那木人开口说道，声音好似木片相击，“你且猜猜，老夫究竟是何方神圣？！”<NL><NL>焕心望望木人，又望望“义父”，险些以为自己身在梦中！

9e7f23ed-08a6-4e2a-9d63-8167ad7541f9/Eve.en: "Yin became empty, as Yang became a deity. Standing in sanctity, onward to immortality.<NL>"Father spoke slowly. Each sentence made the wooden dummy laugh with glee and arrogance.<NL><NL>"Except..."<NL>Father paused as he changed his tone, "you may have cultivated a powerful form, but you lack morality and virtue.<NL>You are no immortal. You will be nothing but a shapeless ghost doomed to wander this plane in an inanimate husk!"
9e7f23ed-08a6-4e2a-9d63-8167ad7541f9/Eve.cn: “阴者化虚空，阳者化为神，遗世而独立，羽化而登仙……”<NL>“义父”缓缓说道，每说一句，那木人便咯嘎一笑，似乎颇为得意……<NL><NL>“只不过……”<NL>“义父”顿了一顿，语气忽转：“只不过，阁下道行虽深，德修却令人不敢恭维，<NL>只怕是——登仙未成反类鬼，托身于物不成形也！”

f9367bd3-1564-4ddd-91ee-860082dba9fe/Eve.en: "Hahaha! A shapeless ghost, you say?"<NL>Unswayed by the provocative words, the wooden dummy raised its claw and began stroking its chin, as if brushing a patch of nonexistent beard.
f9367bd3-1564-4ddd-91ee-860082dba9fe/Eve.cn: “好一个‘登仙未成反类鬼，托身于物不成形’！”<NL>那木人听罢，也不动怒，只抬起木爪往颌下摸去，作捋胡子的模样……
f9367bd3-1564-4ddd-91ee-860082dba9fe/Eve.ru: - Ха-ха-ха! Бесформенный призрак, говоришь?<NL>Не поддавшись на провокационные слова, деревянный манекен поднял клешню и начал поглаживать подбородок, как будто расчесывая клок несуществующей бороды.

f9367bd3-1564-4ddd-91ee-860082dba9fe/Opt.en: "'Foster father'... could this... be an old demon that revived in a 'corpse'?"
f9367bd3-1564-4ddd-91ee-860082dba9fe/Opt.cn: ‘义父’……这莫非……便是一只借“尸”还魂的老妖怪？
f9367bd3-1564-4ddd-91ee-860082dba9fe/Opt.ru: ""Приемный отец"... мог бы это сделать... быть старым демоном, ожившим в "трупе"?"

d659bf25-2233-40dc-a4cc-5ba65b3fb05a/Eve.en: "Your ignorance is appalling, girl!"<NL>The wooden dummy spoke sharply. He turned to your foster father and continued:<NL><NL>"I have been inside the manual in your possession for a long time, yearning for the day that someone will construct a husk worthy of becoming a vessel for my soul!<NL>Yet, my anticipation has been met with failure after failure. Until you, my little blacksmith, managed to grasp the secrets hidden within!<NL>If I weren't in such a rush to return to my corporeal form, I'd keep you alive for longer.<NL><NL>Tell you what, if you let me have all your True Qi so I can regain my physical form,<NL>I'll spare the lives of your life. What do you say?"
d659bf25-2233-40dc-a4cc-5ba65b3fb05a/Eve.cn: “哼！小女娃懂得什么！”<NL>那木人大声斥道，转过头来继续对“义父”说：<NL><NL>“老夫寄身于那秘本已久，只盼有人依秘本之法制出能令老夫还神于世的躯壳！<NL>可惜，那秘本的传人没有一个成器，倒是你这‘小铁匠’，悟到了其中的奥妙！<NL>哼哼，若非老夫还神心切，倒还真舍不得就此将你废了！<NL><NL>这样吧，你速速将一身真气交渡予老夫，好让老夫重塑元神，<NL>老夫便放这小女娃一条生路如何？”

d659bf25-2233-40dc-a4cc-5ba65b3fb05a/Opt.en: "Bah bah bah! Old demon, you talk big! Why don't you beg my 'Foster father' to spare your life!"
d659bf25-2233-40dc-a4cc-5ba65b3fb05a/Opt.cn: 呸呸呸！老妖怪大言不惭！不如你求我‘义父’放你一条生路！
d659bf25-2233-40dc-a4cc-5ba65b3fb05a/Opt.ru: - Ба-ба-ба! Старый демон, ты много говоришь! Почему бы тебе не умолять моего "Приемного отца" сохранить тебе жизнь?"

b3c37502-4c87-48b1-8774-f5a52230d6ca/Eve.en: Just as you finished your angry words, your foster father began to lose his balance and crumbled to the ground.<NL>Horrified, you rushed to his side and helped him sit up<NL>while the wooden dummy let out a sinister laugh with his hand behind his back.
b3c37502-4c87-48b1-8774-f5a52230d6ca/Eve.cn: 焕心愤然直叱，不料话音未落，“义父”已一跤跌倒，<NL>焕心大惊失色，忙去搀扶“义父”盘坐于地……<NL>那木人见状，负手而立，哈哈大笑……
b3c37502-4c87-48b1-8774-f5a52230d6ca/Eve.ru: Как только вы закончили свои гневные слова, ваш приемный отец начал терять равновесие и рухнул на землю.<NL>В ужасе ты бросилась к нему и помогла сесть<NL>в то время как деревянный манекен издал зловещий смешок, заложив руку за спину.

b3c37502-4c87-48b1-8774-f5a52230d6ca/Opt.en: (I didn't expect 'Foster father' to be so seriously injured; no wonder the old demon is so confident!)
b3c37502-4c87-48b1-8774-f5a52230d6ca/Opt.cn: （想不到‘义父’受伤如此之重，怪不得老妖怪有恃无恐！）
b3c37502-4c87-48b1-8774-f5a52230d6ca/Opt.ru: (Я не ожидал, что "Приемный отец" будет так серьезно ранен; неудивительно, что старый демон так уверен в себе!)

d3ed391f-7c3c-4d76-a172-94c935069a64/Eve.en: "You're no match for me, little girl. Kowtow to me thrice and call me Immortal Xu trice.<NL>Then, I'll allow you to tuck tail and run!"
d3ed391f-7c3c-4d76-a172-94c935069a64/Eve.cn: “小女娃莫要挡道，快向老夫磕三个响头，<NL>唤老夫三声‘徐仙公’，就此逃命去罢！”
d3ed391f-7c3c-4d76-a172-94c935069a64/Eve.ru: - Ты мне не ровня, малышка. Трижды поклонись мне и трижды назови меня Бессмертным Сюй.<NL>Тогда я позволю тебе поджать хвост и убежать!"

d3ed391f-7c3c-4d76-a172-94c935069a64/Opt.en: "Evil demon and old monster! You still have the nerve to call yourself Immortal Xu? Without my 'Foster father' stepping in, I'll beat you back to your original form right now!"
d3ed391f-7c3c-4d76-a172-94c935069a64/Opt.cn: 邪魔外道老妖怪！还有脸自称徐仙公，不用我‘义父’出手，我这便将你打回原形！
d3ed391f-7c3c-4d76-a172-94c935069a64/Opt.ru: - Злой демон и старое чудовище! У тебя все еще хватает наглости называть себя Бессмертным Сюй? Без вмешательства моего "приемного отца" я верну тебе твою первоначальную форму прямо сейчас!"

61fcc515-5bf3-492b-83f9-1daa9ddc0a1e/Eve.en: "Xin'er, don't make a sound..."<NL><NL>Huanxin was about to fight with Immortal Xu when 'Foster father' suddenly spoke to her using the method of "secret sound transmission":<NL>"This Immortal Xu is strange and unfathomable; ordinary moves are useless against him.<NL>But when 'Foster father' made this Wooden Dummy, its legs had a major flaw.<NL>Wait for an opportunity and attack its lower body with 'The Opening and Closing Sword'!"<NL><NL>Huanxin listened silently to 'Foster father's' guidance and instantly understood!
61fcc515-5bf3-492b-83f9-1daa9ddc0a1e/Eve.cn: “心儿，莫作声……”<NL><NL>焕心正要上前与徐仙公相斗，“义父”忽然以“传音入秘”之法对焕心说话：<NL>“这徐仙公古怪叵测，寻常招数对他无用，<NL>但‘义父’制此木人之时，木人的双腿尚有重大缺陷，<NL>你伺机以「开阖剑术」攻它下盘！”<NL><NL>焕心不动声色的倾听“义父”的指点，心中立即会意！

d8867c1e-df42-45c0-8c47-b3f885abb71e/Eve.en: "To execute martial arts, you must inhale, focus your mind, and establish a firm stance..."
d8867c1e-df42-45c0-8c47-b3f885abb71e/Eve.cn: “若要施展功法，需得提气凝神，立稳门户……”
d8867c1e-df42-45c0-8c47-b3f885abb71e/Eve.ru: "Чтобы заниматься Боевыми искусствами, вы должны вдохнуть, сосредоточить свой разум и принять твердую Стойку..."

b2bc167c-d5b2-4868-a0a9-27f80716feaa/Eve.en: Huanxin launched three consecutive sword strikes, yet every single one was parried by Immortal Xu! <NL>"Shoot! My two Upswings and a Stab have all been parried by that old guy. This makes me unable to unleash the Opening and Closing Sword!<NL>What should I do?"
b2bc167c-d5b2-4868-a0a9-27f80716feaa/Eve.cn: 焕心连攻三剑，不料均被徐仙公一一化解！<NL>“糟糕！我这两「撩」、一「刺」皆被老妖怪化解，那「开阖剑术」便使不出来，<NL>这可如何是好？！”
b2bc167c-d5b2-4868-a0a9-27f80716feaa/Eve.ru: Хуаньсинь нанесла три последовательных удара Мечом, но каждый из них был парирован Бессмертным Сюем! <NL>- Стреляй! Два моих взмаха и удар ножом были парированы этим стариком. Из-за этого я не могу высвободить Открывающий и закрывающий Меч!<NL>Что мне следует делать?"

88c58120-9a28-4d1b-99ee-7c7794415f3f/Eve.en: "You might be young and inexperienced, but you've got some talent with that sword.However... hehe.<NL>Even with this unwieldy body, I can still see through your attacks with ease.<NL>Your attempts are nothing but futile!"
88c58120-9a28-4d1b-99ee-7c7794415f3f/Eve.cn: “小女娃功力虽浅，剑势倒很凌厉！不过……嘿嘿！<NL>虽然老夫如今这副身躯行动起来多有不便，但以老夫的眼力，<NL>你那点微末招数又济得什么用？！”
88c58120-9a28-4d1b-99ee-7c7794415f3f/Eve.ru: - Может, ты и молод и неопытен, но у тебя есть некоторый Талант обращаться с этим Мечом.Однако... хе-хе.<NL>Даже с таким громоздким телом я все еще с легкостью вижу твои атаки насквозь.<NL>Ваши попытки не что иное, как тщетны!"

88c58120-9a28-4d1b-99ee-7c7794415f3f/Opt.en: You will pay for your arrogance! Eat this!
88c58120-9a28-4d1b-99ee-7c7794415f3f/Opt.cn: 哼！老妖怪休要猖狂！再看剑！
88c58120-9a28-4d1b-99ee-7c7794415f3f/Opt.ru: Ты заплатишь за свое высокомерие! Съешь это!

347ece68-7299-4b5f-877d-14b8fb8f1018/Eve.en: With a crisp cry, you raised your sword and stabbed forward. Immortal Xu flicked his left hand,<NL>and your blade began to tilt away from its trajectory and missed its intended target.<NL><NL>"Your attempts are futile!" With an almost mechanical cry, Immortal Xu raised his right hand like a claw and lunged toward your meridian on your wrist!
347ece68-7299-4b5f-877d-14b8fb8f1018/Eve.cn: 焕心一声清咤，挺剑再刺，徐仙公左手一挥，<NL>焕心剑尖斜转，又刺在了空处……<NL><NL>“螳臂挡车！”徐仙公咯嘎一声，右手成爪，便来拿焕心手腕上的脉门！

0952f0f7-c939-4a40-aafa-e29499e0847b/Eve.en: "Bend low and hold the sword horizontally, hack its right elbow!"<NL>At that critical moment, 'Foster father' suddenly spoke via "secret sound"!<NL>Huanxin didn't have time to think; she immediately swung her sword like a blade and hacked across,<NL>The timing and angle of this hack were perfect, to the finest detail, and Immortal Xu was indeed startled and withdrew his hand!<NL><NL>"Now's the chance! Aim for the legs! Strike three times in a row!" 'Foster father' followed immediately!
0952f0f7-c939-4a40-aafa-e29499e0847b/Eve.cn: “弓腰横剑，劈它右肘！”<NL>当此间不容发之际，“义父”突然“传音”说道！<NL>焕心无暇细想，立即以剑作刀横劈过去，<NL>这一劈的时机、方位无不恰到好处，妙到巅毫，徐仙公果然怵而收手！<NL><NL>“机不可失！看准双腿！连劈三剑！”‘义父’紧接着道！

182d18dd-9848-4c46-a21b-eacaf2f0429f/Eve.en: "Use Ao Slaying Blade Art with your sword!"<NL>Foster Father shouted loudly, but this time the voice was no longer projected into your ears directly.<NL>Hearing this, Immortal Xu stumbled on his left foot in surprise, revealing the opening in his legs!
182d18dd-9848-4c46-a21b-eacaf2f0429f/Eve.cn: “当以剑化刀！使「斩鳌刀法」！”<NL>“义父”高声说道，这次却已不是“传音入秘”！<NL>徐仙公闻言大吃一惊，左足一个踉跄，双腿破绽尽现！
182d18dd-9848-4c46-a21b-eacaf2f0429f/Eve.ru: "Используй Искусство клинка Ао для убийства своим Мечом!"<NL>Приемный отец громко закричал, но на этот раз голос больше не проецировался непосредственно в ваши уши.<NL>Услышав это, Бессмертный Сюй от удивления споткнулся на левой ноге, открыв отверстие в своих ногах!

182d18dd-9848-4c46-a21b-eacaf2f0429f/Opt.en: Exactly! The Ao Slaying Blade Art specializes in cutting legs and feet—the perfect way to strike the vital point!
182d18dd-9848-4c46-a21b-eacaf2f0429f/Opt.cn: 不错！「斩鳌刀法」专斩腿脚，正可攻其命门！
182d18dd-9848-4c46-a21b-eacaf2f0429f/Opt.ru: Вот именно! Искусство клинка Ao Slaying специализируется на разделке ног и ступней — идеальный способ нанести удар в жизненно важную точку!

ea8f67a4-96e2-4c40-aacd-124489f5d0ec/Eve.en: Fast enough, a complete set of blade art and formulas leaped vividly before Huanxin's eyes.<NL><NL>The Posture of the Ao Slaying Blade Art is low and crouching, specialized for severing legs and feet.<NL>Legend says, "Nüwa cut off the turtle's legs to prop up the four poles of heaven."<NL>This blade art is named "Ao Slaying," meaning a single slash can sever the legs that uphold the four poles.<NL>The power it wields is extraordinary, beyond compare.
ea8f67a4-96e2-4c40-aacd-124489f5d0ec/Eve.cn: 说时迟，那时快，一套刀法心诀跃然焕心的眼前——<NL><NL>斩鳌刀法姿态低伏，专斩腿脚。<NL>传说“女娲断鳌足以立四极”，<NL>此刀法名曰“斩鳌”，意为一刀便可将擎持玄黄四极之支柱斩断，<NL>力量之大，非比寻常。

b4453af4-7ad6-4a58-b9ce-41689b02fc5b/Eve.en: "You lost, freak!"<NL>Not even halfway through unleashing the powerful Ao Slaying Blade Art,<NL>Immortal Xu was already suffering from a heavy blow to his chest. His legs shattered as he let out a chilling cry before falling to the ground.<NL>Despite knowing the fact that you are only slicing a wooden dummy, you still couldn't help but feel a sense of sympathy toward it...
b4453af4-7ad6-4a58-b9ce-41689b02fc5b/Eve.cn: “老妖怪，你输了！”<NL>焕心挥剑猛砍，一套「斩鳌刀法」尚未使完，<NL>徐仙公已胸口受创、双足尽断，怪叫一声，摔倒在地！<NL>焕心明知剑下所斩的乃是一具木人，但还是不禁心生怜悯，那最后一剑便劈不下去……

b4453af4-7ad6-4a58-b9ce-41689b02fc5b/Opt.en: "Does... does it hurt...? Hmph! Serves you right, old demon! Just wait and see how my 'Foster father' deals with you!"
b4453af4-7ad6-4a58-b9ce-41689b02fc5b/Opt.cn: 很……很痛么……哼！老妖怪活该！且看我‘义父’如何处置你！
b4453af4-7ad6-4a58-b9ce-41689b02fc5b/Opt.ru: - Делает... это больно...? Хм! Так тебе и надо, старый демон! Просто подожди и увидишь, как мой "Приемный отец" поступит с тобой!"

48fa42c7-bd65-4f9d-9779-914a6b59bfe2/Eve.en: "Wood naturally... doesn't hurt... Little girl, you're being unreasonable!<NL>This time, I underestimated the enemy! Your sword is certainly sharp, and 'little blacksmith' is even more resourceful!<NL>Hehe! Impressive! Impressive!"
48fa42c7-bd65-4f9d-9779-914a6b59bfe2/Eve.cn: “木头自然是……不会痛的……小女娃莫名其妙！<NL>这次是老夫轻敌了！小女娃的剑固然锋利，‘小铁匠’更是应变无方！<NL>嘿嘿！了不起！了不起！”
48fa42c7-bd65-4f9d-9779-914a6b59bfe2/Eve.ru: - Дерево, естественно... не причиняет боли... Малышка, ты ведешь себя неразумно!<NL>На этот раз я недооценил врага! Твой Меч, безусловно, остер, а "маленький кузнец" еще более находчив!<NL>Хе-хе! Впечатляет! Впечатляет!"

48fa42c7-bd65-4f9d-9779-914a6b59bfe2/Opt.en: "What little blacksmith? Are you trying to take advantage of my 'Foster father'?"
48fa42c7-bd65-4f9d-9779-914a6b59bfe2/Opt.cn: 什么小铁匠啊？你讨我‘义父’便宜吗！
48fa42c7-bd65-4f9d-9779-914a6b59bfe2/Opt.ru: - Какой маленький кузнец? Ты пытаешься воспользоваться моим "приемным отцом"?"

226f7839-dd06-4908-b304-546f0a6688c8/Eve.en: "Do... do not waste your breath with him, my daughter!"
226f7839-dd06-4908-b304-546f0a6688c8/Eve.ru: - Не... не трать на него зря время, дочь моя!

226f7839-dd06-4908-b304-546f0a6688c8/Opt.en: "Yes, 'Foster father', but this old demon is neither human nor object. How should we deal with him?"
226f7839-dd06-4908-b304-546f0a6688c8/Opt.cn: 是，‘义父’，但这老妖怪似人非人，似物非物，该当如何处置？
226f7839-dd06-4908-b304-546f0a6688c8/Opt.ru: - Да, "Приемный отец", но этот старый демон не является ни человеком, ни объектом. Как нам следует с ним поступить?"

240b2438-5ec4-4667-8efd-9189a37ab6c8/Eve.en: "Preposterous! Such arrogance!<NL>What can you insignificant mortals expect to do?<NL>I am divinity in the flesh. You can destroy my vessel a thousand times,<NL>but it'll only take my soul three days to reemerge from the ashes to exact my vengeance!"<NL><NL>Immortal Xu spoke in disdain as he rammed the Parasol branches you threw on the ground<NL>at the dummy's wounds and broken limbs.
240b2438-5ec4-4667-8efd-9189a37ab6c8/Eve.cn: “如何处置？笑话！<NL>尔等凡夫俗子，又能奈老夫如何？<NL>老夫乃神仙化身，托身的躯壳纵使被毁，<NL>不出三日，便又可重聚灵神，报仇雪恨！”<NL><NL>徐仙公边说，边从地上抓起焕心先前抛在地上的梧桐木，<NL>不断往木人的创口和断肢上拼接……

240b2438-5ec4-4667-8efd-9189a37ab6c8/Opt.en: "Bah! Old demon, you're boasting! Hey! That's the Parasol wood I gathered for 'Foster father', how can you take it without asking!"
240b2438-5ec4-4667-8efd-9189a37ab6c8/Opt.cn: 呸呸！老妖怪胡吹大气！喂！那是我给‘义父’采来的梧桐木，你怎能不问自取！
240b2438-5ec4-4667-8efd-9189a37ab6c8/Opt.ru: - Ба! Старый демон, ты хвастаешься! Эй! Это дерево для зонтика, которое я собрал для "Приемного отца", как ты можешь брать его без спроса!"

205be5bc-ab84-46b7-98fe-f837fac7ad5f/Eve.en: "Xin'er, come over to 'Foster father' and let Immortal Xu do as he pleases.<NL>We have no good way to drive him away or destroy him, but in two days,<NL>when my power is restored, it won't be so easy for Immortal Xu to covertly harm us father and daughter!"<NL><NL>'Foster father' said coldly, while Immortal Xu pretended not to hear and continued mending his broken body...
205be5bc-ab84-46b7-98fe-f837fac7ad5f/Eve.cn: “心儿，你到‘义父’这边来，且由徐仙公自便罢，<NL>我等确无良策将徐仙公驱灭，但等到两日之后，<NL>我功力复元，徐仙公再想暗害我父女二人，却也不会这般容易！”<NL><NL>“义父”冷冷地说道，徐仙公只作不闻，兀自修整着残躯……

4b98ef4d-0828-4c99-b889-f217ac4d56ca/Eve.en: Your foster father passed concerned glances at you as you returned.<NL>"My daughter, are you injured? Why is there blood on the wood in Immortal Xu's hand?"<NL><NL>You smiled with glee as you twirled around.
4b98ef4d-0828-4c99-b889-f217ac4d56ca/Eve.cn: 焕心回到“义父”身边，“义父”将焕心上下打量一番，问道：<NL>“心儿，那徐仙公手上的木头怎会沾有血迹，你哪里受伤了吗？”<NL><NL>焕心闻言嘻嘻一笑，踮起小脚转了一圈……
4b98ef4d-0828-4c99-b889-f217ac4d56ca/Eve.ru: Твой приемный отец бросил на тебя обеспокоенный взгляд, когда ты вернулся.<NL>- Дочь моя, ты ранена? Почему на дереве в руке Бессмертного Сюя кровь?"<NL><NL>Ты радостно улыбалась, кружась вокруг меня.

4b98ef4d-0828-4c99-b889-f217ac4d56ca/Opt.en: "'Foster father', don't worry! That bloodstain was left when I cut wood and was pricked by a branch..."
4b98ef4d-0828-4c99-b889-f217ac4d56ca/Opt.cn: ‘义父’莫担心！那血迹是我砍木头时，给木枝刺伤留下的……
4b98ef4d-0828-4c99-b889-f217ac4d56ca/Opt.ru: - "Приемный отец", не волнуйся! Это кровавое пятно осталось, когда я рубил дрова и укололся веткой..."

One does not simply escape from destiny..."<NL>Father nodded contemplatively before shakily standing upright.<NL>He walked toward Immortal Xu, smoothed out his attire and spoke:<NL>"That is not how you install those joints. Shall I lend you a hand?"<NL><NL>As Father spoke, you and Immortal Xu couldn't help but let out a gasp of astonishment.
2568d9c3-d0e0-4b37-a5be-8b50452fa7ee/Eve.cn: “原来如此……真乃天意……”<NL>“义父”意味深长的点了点头，随后勉强站起身来，<NL>接着，缓缓走到徐仙公面前，理了理衣衫，对徐仙公说道：<NL>“这几处‘窍要’你装的不对，还是让我来帮你吧！”<NL><NL>“义父”此言一出，焕心与徐仙公都不禁惊呼出声……
